text:
maya: quick thread on provisional token evaporation vs late-arrival reconciliation. need a concise contract.
samir: agree. runtime provisional vs compact canonical?
maya: yep. provisional = fast path, compact = authoritative once compacted.
liam: sketch: add evaporate_at timestamp on envelope, keep provisional until then. reconciler can merge before evaporate_at. after that emit evaporated audit and tombstone provisional.
nora: dedupe key must be consistent across both paths. propose dedupe := sha256(tenant|fingerprint|source|seq).
ops-carol: per-tenant overrides for windows okay but ops complexity rises. recommend global defaults + enterprise overrides.
infra-bot: note: billing-keeper runs every 2m by default. recon frequency may need tuning.
samir: backfills: never auto-rewrite historical invoices. write adjustment candidates for manual approval.
liam: runtime should emit parent_id for split requests so ingest can stitch before dedupe. optional field.
maya: audit retention: full audit 90d, aggregated ballots 2y, tenant-SLA can extend.
ops-carol: emergency rollback = append negative adjustments; do not mutate originals. ops UI for approvals.
nora: action items: samir schema PR, liam dedupe spike, nora policy doc, ops-carol UI mock, infra to tune jobs.
maya: defaults suggestion: soft_window=5m, hard_cutoff=24h. telemetry and iterate.
liam: +1. also alert on evaporation spike -> pages eng-platform.
infra-bot: alert created: "evaporation-spike" -> page eng-platform on >50/min for 5m.
maya: thanks all, closing. :thumbsup:
